name: Voie de Chaise
descent_text: Most parties rappel the route itself using two 60m ropes tied together — several rap stations leave less than 5 ft of rope to spare, so careful rope management and knots in the ends are essential. The East Gully offers an alternative walk-off/scramble descent.
itinerary: Depart Alpental in the morning; 2-3 hrs approach to the East Face; climb the 8-pitch route; rappel the route (two 60m ropes) or descend the East Gully back to the basin.

waypoints.name: Alpental parking lot / Snow Lake TH #1013
waypoints.directions: From I-90 take Exit 52 (Snoqualmie Pass West) and turn left (north), passing under the freeway. Take the second right onto Alpental Road and drive about 1.3 miles to its end at the Alpental Ski Area parking lot, at about 3,100 ft, where the Snow Lake Trail #1013 starts. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park, and a free self-issue wilderness permit is required.

waypoints.name: Chair Peak summit
waypoints.directions: Take the summer trail toward Source Lake; where it meets the talus, hold your height rather than dropping, pass the small cliff bands on your right, and leave the trail at a longer talus field marked by a large cairn. Climb up and left to the snow patch under the east face, up it and the last loose scree hugging the base, then go left past the end of the rock band to the first bolted line. Eight bolted pitches and a short exposed scramble lead to the summit.
